cover.composition: Blue upper field, bold white title; short explanation in the white lower field

statement.composition: Dark field, bold thesis; one consequence beneath it

content.job: Explain with two or three arguments
content.composition: Bold title on the left, open argument rows on the right; first line is a lead

split.job: Compare the same thing in two states
split.composition: Small labels over large comparison text; equal columns and a vertical divider. First line is the label, following lines are the comparison

steps.composition: Title on the left, numbered vertical sequence on the right; first line is the step name

metrics.composition: Large numerals with nearby units; visible context beneath; never invent performance figures

chart.composition: Signed bars from a zero baseline; clear units; no decorative chart

table.composition: Blue header band, quiet horizontal rules; equal column widths. Explanation goes in notes

image.composition: One registered customer-supplied image, aspect ratio preserved; no generated or decorative illustration

closing.job: Ask for one concrete next action
closing.composition: Blue title on white; full-width blue lower band with the next action
